g.text: Called by UC-04, UC-06 or UC-08 with proposal and retrieved context.
baseControl is a formal role bound to the calling Control, not a new class.

Every prevented branch skips later checks; cancelled permits no assignment.

The base workflow supplies context; this interaction performs no database read or write.
